'''HP-17B''' is an [[infix notation|algebraic entry]] [[financial calculator|financial and business calculator]] manufactured by [[Hewlett-Packard]], introduced on 4 January 1988 along with the [[HP-19B]], [[HP-27S]] and the [[HP-28S]]. It was a simplified business model, like the 19B. There were two versions, the US one working in [[English language|English]] only, and the international one with a choice of six languages (English, [[German language|German]], [[Spanish language|Spanish]], [[French language|French]], [[Italian language|Italian]], and [[Portuguese language|Portuguese]]).

== <span class="anchor" id="17B"></span>HP-17B ==
HP-17B code name was ''Trader'' and it belonged to the Pioneer series of Hewlett-Packard calculators.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.fbalzer.de/tr/pioneer.html |title=Frank Balzer's HP Calculator Collection |website=www.fbalzer.de |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020130180953/http://fbalzer.de/tr/pioneer.html |archive-date=2002-01-30}} </ref> It had a 131×16 [[Dot matrix display|LCD dot matrix]], 22×2 characters, menu-driven display,<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.thimet.de/calccollection/Calculators/HP-17BII/Contents.htm |title=Hp-17B/17Bii/17B+ |access-date=2010-04-24 |archive-date=2010-04-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100418020104/http://www.thimet.de/CalcCollection/Calculators/HP-17BII/Contents.htm |url-status=dead}}</ref> used a [[Saturn (microprocessor)|Saturn processor]] and had a memory of 8000 [[bytes]], of which 6750 bytes were available to the user for variable and equation storage. The HP-17B had a clock with alarm that allowed for basic agenda capabilities, as well an [[infrared port]] for printing to some Hewlett-Packard infrared [[Printer (computing)|printers]].

== <span class="anchor" id="17BII"></span><span class="anchor" id="F1638A"></span>HP 17BII ==
The 17B was replaced by the '''HP 17BII''' (F1638A) (code name ''Trader II'') in January 1990, which added [[Reverse Polish notation|RPN]] entry.

== <span class="anchor" id="17bII+"></span><span class="anchor" id="F2234A"></span>HP 17bII+ ==
The 17BII was replaced by the '''HP 17bII+''' in 2003. Two significantly different case variants of the 17bII+ exist. The newer 17bII+ (F2234A), introduced in 2007, with [[Sunplus|Sunplus Technology]] [[Sunplus SPLB31A|SPLB31A]] CPU was developed and is manufactured by [[Kinpo Electronics]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.kinpo.com.tw/English/product_consumer_1.html#17bll+ |title=Kinpo Electronics &#124; the most trusted partner in manufacturing}}</ref>
